newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean stocks close down on broad-based selling.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean stocks close down on broad-based selling.

text.p: South Korean stocks closed lower Saturday's half-day session on broad-based selling amid concerns that a technical correction was inevitable, brokers said.
Lingering fears over rumours of corporate financial troubles also added on selling pressure, they said.
The composite index shed 5.36 points to close at 725.17.
"Selling was steady as investors thought a downward correction was inevitable following the sharp gains by early this week," said Hwang Chang-joong of LG Securities.
Blue chips also fell with fading hopes for benefits from the Japanese yen's recent rise against the dollar, brokers said.
Daewoo Heavy Industries, one of the main gainers from the market's recent rally based on the yen's rise, fell 450 won to close at 7,230.
Samsung Electronics was unmoved by news that it had signed an agreement with Intel Corp to work on future computer and consumer electronics projects. Samsung fell 300 won to 61,600.
